item: Row 260: Wikipedia coverage in Field data, read back by a script
summary: 0.6 gate row D's operator item (the twelve-edition report read back from a real run): the Field data button also saves oo-field-{press}-wiki-coverage.json from the loopback /api/wiki/lane/counters (counts, dates, edition codes; no title, text or address), cut to 200 KB pieces; scripts/wiki_coverage_readback.py (stdlib) joins the pieces and prints each edition's pages seen, total state, full-text range, last event and gaps, then the located counters, never an absent figure as 0.
